src/stock.ts: export function available(input:any):Record<string,number>{const out={...input.stock};for(const r of input.reservations){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(out,r.sku)&&r.expires>input.now)out[r.sku]-=r.quantity;}for(const k of Object.keys(out))out[k]=Math.max(0,out[k]);return out;}
